summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the new enquiry feature and regression testing. All enquiry flows work correctly: guest enquiries with email, phone-only enquiries, validation, and signed-in user enquiries with pre-filled email. Language switching to Bulgarian confirmed. All detail page sections present. Back button and search functionality working.
